source_analysis.skill: Multiply two ordered 3x3 integer matrices by row-column dot products and assemble the product.
reasoning_steps: Identify the ordered left and right matrices.
For each required output position (i,j), pair row i of the left matrix with column j of the right.
Multiply three corresponding pairs and sum with correct signs, including zeros and cancellations.
Assemble all nine entries or complete five missing entries; select the complete product when radio.
invariants: Order matters: AB is not generally BA.
Small integer signed arithmetic; no inverses, determinants or symbolic parameters.
Shown solution expands each required dot product before its result.
permitted_variations: All eighteen input entries including zero placement and sign may change.
Matrix labels, operand display and order may change provided dependencies follow.
The five blank positions may change; their source placement is incidental.
Correct choice position and error locations may change; source sparse/repeated rows are incidental.
Authored difficulty may reduce zero support and increase required independent dot products while retaining manageable integers.
